name: domesday
description: Domesday: a walk-through fixed asset register. Monorepo for the API, web app, phone app, database and GPU workers.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:db && pnpm run test:py
scripts.test:py: cd workers/gpu && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest; else python3 -m pytest; fi
scripts.tokens:sync: pnpm --filter @domesday/tokens run sync && pnpm run tokens
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run depcruise && pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:db && pnpm run test:py
